toolchain: smali 3.0.9, assembled deterministically by scripts/prepare_tools.py from policy/build-tools.json (13 pinned upstream jars)

version_dependent_artifacts.note: api.json, live.m3u and dc.json carry the version in their CDN base URL, so their hashes only hold for verified_version. cfg.jpg has no version inside it, so plugin_sha256 stays valid for every version built from the same source.

method: two consecutive local builds on the same machine, every artifact compared byte-for-byte; no published file may be stamped with a build time or repeated builds stop matching
